import: Individual measured alpha bounds via Unity sprite importer; no raster repainting or generated frame interpolation.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sprite parts atlas for a simple top-down pixel art fantasy game, a giant scorpion boss named Shaula.
Reference 1 is the old boss identity only (charcoal shell, pale ivory joints and claw teeth, a small white star on the tail stinger); reference 2 is the tiny existing hero style. Replace the old noisy, overly detailed art with crisp low-detail game pixel art.

Create ONE transparent PNG atlas arranged in an exact 3 columns by 3 rows equal-cell grid. No labels or grid lines. Each component stays fully inside its own cell with wide transparent margins, never touches another cell. Every piece has opaque flat color interiors and a clean black pixel outline; true transparent background, no matte, no shadows baked into the image, no visual effects. Use chunky pixel clusters and about 8 flat colors, no gradients, soft edges, texture noise, tiny highlights, or antialiasing. Match a sprite drawn on a roughly 128 by 128 pixel logical grid for the whole atlas and enlarged with nearest-neighbor pixels. This is a disassembled 2D animation puppet, not nine whole scorpions.

Exact cell content reading row-major:
Row 1 col 1: the main scorpion body INCLUDING a small head facing straight DOWN. Elongated vertical plated oval abdomen, rounded rear at TOP, angular small head and two amber eyes at BOTTOM. NO legs, NO tail, NO pincers attached. Dark charcoal shell with 3 large simple armor segments and pale ivory seam at bottom. Symmetrical top-down view with a little upper-surface depth.
Row 1 col 2: ONE isolated large OPEN pincer facing straight DOWN, wrist attachment at TOP, black oval shell, two ivory inward-curved teeth at BOTTOM with a clear opening between them.
Row 1 col 3: the SAME pincer CLOSED, same size and wrist position, teeth closed at bottom.
Row 2 col 1: ONE short thick upper leg segment horizontally from LEFT joint to RIGHT joint, black armor on top, small ivory round socket at each end. Straight horizontal, compact.
Row 2 col 2: ONE lower leg segment horizontally LEFT to RIGHT, thicker on LEFT socket tapering to a pointed dark foot at RIGHT, small ivory joint. Straight, no attached extra parts.
Row 2 col 3: ONE longer pincer forearm segment horizontally LEFT to RIGHT, dark armor, pale round joints, about twice as long as the upper leg.
Row 3 col 1: ONE tail segment, vertical short rounded dark armor plate, socket TOP and BOTTOM, ivory joint at bottom. No tail assembly.
Row 3 col 2: ONE bulbous tail-tip stinger, socket at TOP, round dark armored bulb centered, one small white four-point star on the bulb, ivory sharp tip pointing DOWN. No attached tail segments.
Row 3 col 3: ONE complete harmless tiny scorpion facing DOWN for the boss shrinking finish, same palette, no stars or effects around it.

Keep the body parts orthographic and compatible to assemble into one boss. Normal phase charcoal only. No red pixels, no blood, no gore, no text, no watermark.
cleanupPrompt: Precise-object-edit, production sprite atlas cleanup. Edit only this atlas. Preserve exactly the nine components, their shapes, palette, positions and 3 by 3 arrangement. Remove EVERY yellow glow, outer shadow, dark background, haze and all semitransparent halo pixels surrounding each sprite. Background must be completely alpha=0 transparent up to the crisp black outlines. The interiors and black outlines of every part must be fully opaque. Hard-edged chunky pixel art only. No blurs, no gradients, no antialiasing at edges, no shadow under any part. Keep the ivory joints and highlights inside sprites. This is for direct Unity sprite import and any background glow is a defect. Do not add text, extra objects or effects. Entire sprites inside cells and at least 24px transparent margin from all borders.
